decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The use of the first floor bedroom indicated on the submitted drawings for the provision of alternative therapy, hereby approved, shall be restricted for use only by the resident of the property, as detailed on the related application form for planning decision reference 00487/36/P1 and no other persons shall be employed at the site for purposes related to the provision of the use, hereby approved.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for alternative therapy purposes shall not be carried on outside the hours of 10.00am - 5.00pm Monday to Friday and shall not operate on weekends.
description: The change of use of a residential bedroom to use as an alternative therapy practice.
